about: The few words the chart kit's figure prints that are the same on every chart. A spec's "words" object may override any of them. The editor owns their wording; the engineer keeps the keys.
unlabeled_marks: Not labeled at this width: {codes}. The table names every one.
unlabeled_tiles: At this width the tiles are too small for state codes. The table names every state.
scripts_off: This chart needs JavaScript, which this browser has turned off. Its figures are in the table below.
export_fonts: Set in Inter and Inter Tight. On a computer without both fonts, the labels fall back to another font and change width.
